3-1-1.q: True or false: God reveals himself through creation, his word and his Son. The Bible is his word written by humans.
Which word fits? “God showing himself and his plan to us, in the Bible and in Jesus.”
3-1-1.why: Revelation: God showing himself and his plan to us, in the Bible and in Jesus.

3-1-1.q: Which word fits? “The Bible: God’s word written by people he inspired.”
3-1-1.why: Scripture: The Bible: God’s word written by people he inspired.

3-1-1.q: Catechism 53: “The divine plan of _____ is realized simultaneously "by deeds and words which are intrinsically bound up with each other" and shed light on each another.”
3-1-1.why: CCC 53: “The divine plan of Revelation is realized simultaneously "by deeds and words which are intrinsically bound up with each other" and shed light on each another.”

3-1-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “God speaks to us” teaches? “He spent his life translating the Bible so people could know Christ.”
3-1-1.why: Jerome: he spent his life translating the Bible so people could know Christ.

3-1-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “God speaks to us”?
3-1-1.why: Hebrews 1:1-2 is the passage for this lesson.

3-1-2.q: True or false: The Bible has 73 books. The Old Testament tells of God’s promises. The New Testament tells of Jesus.
Which word fits? “The 46 books of God’s covenant with Israel before Christ.”
3-1-2.why: Old Testament: The 46 books of God’s covenant with Israel before Christ.

3-1-2.q: Which word fits? “The 27 books about Jesus and the early Church.”
3-1-2.why: New Testament: The 27 books about Jesus and the early Church.

3-1-2.q: Catechism 120: “It was by the _____ Tradition that the Church discerned which writings are to be included in the list of the sacred books.”
3-1-2.why: CCC 120: “It was by the apostolic Tradition that the Church discerned which writings are to be included in the list of the sacred books.”

3-1-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Bible: our holy book” teaches? “Patron of Bible scholars.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Bible: our holy book”?
3-1-2.why: 2 Timothy 3:16 is the passage for this lesson.

3-1-3.q: True or false: A covenant is a special promise. God made covenants with Noah, Abraham, Moses and David. Jesus makes the new covenant.
Which word fits? “A sacred promise-bond between God and his people.”
3-1-3.why: covenant: A sacred promise-bond between God and his people.

3-1-3.q: Which word fits? “God’s plan unfolding through events from creation to Christ.”
3-1-3.why: salvation history: God’s plan unfolding through events from creation to Christ.

3-1-3.q: Catechism 64: “Through the prophets, God forms his people in the hope of salvation, in the expectation of a new and everlasting _____ intended for all, to be written on their hearts.”
3-1-3.why: CCC 64: “Through the prophets, God forms his people in the hope of salvation, in the expectation of a new and everlasting Covenant intended for all, to be written on their hearts.”

3-1-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Covenant: God’s promise” teaches? “Our father in faith.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Covenant: God’s promise”?
3-1-3.why: Genesis 9:8-17 is the passage for this lesson.

3-2-1.q: True or false: The first three commandments show how to love God: he comes first, speak his name with respect, keep Sunday holy.
Which word fits? “The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.”
3-2-1.why: Ten Commandments: The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.

3-2-1.q: Which word fits? “The day of rest and worship; for Christians, Sunday.”
3-2-1.why: Sabbath: The day of rest and worship; for Christians, Sunday.

3-2-1.q: Catechism 2083: “You shall not make for yourself a graven image, or any likeness of anything that is in _____ above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth;”
3-2-1.why: CCC 2083: “You shall not make for yourself a graven image, or any likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth;”

3-2-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Loving God” teaches? “He put God first.”
3-2-1.why: Thomas More: he put God first.

3-2-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Loving God”?
3-2-1.why: Exodus 20:1-11 is the passage for this lesson.

3-2-2.q: True or false: The last seven commandments teach us to honor family, respect life, be faithful, honest and generous.
Which word fits? “The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.”
3-2-2.why: Ten Commandments: The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.

3-2-2.q: Which word fits? “Giving to God and to each person what is due to them.”
3-2-2.why: justice: Giving to God and to each person what is due to them.

3-2-2.q: Catechism 2401: “It commands _____ and charity in the care of earthly goods and the fruits of men's labor.”
3-2-2.why: CCC 2401: “It commands justice and charity in the care of earthly goods and the fruits of men's labor.”

3-2-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Loving our neighbor” teaches? “They lived the fourth commandment in their family.”
3-2-2.why: Louis and Zélie Martin: they lived the fourth commandment in their family.

3-2-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Loving our neighbor”?
3-2-2.why: Exodus 20:12-17 is the passage for this lesson.

3-2-3.q: True or false: We use our conscience to follow God’s law. We learn it, pray and ask advice.
Which word fits? “The inner voice of judgment that helps us know right from wrong.”
3-2-3.why: conscience: The inner voice of judgment that helps us know right from wrong.

3-2-3.q: Which word fits? “The habit of choosing well how to do good in each situation.”
3-2-3.why: prudence: The habit of choosing well how to do good in each situation.

3-2-3.q: Catechism 1776: “"Deep within his _____ man discovers a law which he has not laid upon himself but which he must obey.”
3-2-3.why: CCC 1776: “"Deep within his conscience man discovers a law which he has not laid upon himself but which he must obey.”

3-2-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Following with a good conscience” teaches? “He taught that conscience binds.”
3-2-3.why: Thomas Aquinas: he taught that conscience binds.

3-2-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Following with a good conscience”?
3-2-3.why: Romans 2:15 is the passage for this lesson.

3-3-1.q: True or false: Jesus gives eight paths to blessing. They show a life of trust and love.
Which word fits? “Jesus’ eight sayings on the path to true happiness.”
3-3-1.why: Beatitudes: Jesus’ eight sayings on the path to true happiness.

3-3-1.q: Catechism 1716: “the _____ fulfill the promises by ordering them no longer merely to the possession of a territory, but to the Kingdom of heaven:”
3-3-1.why: CCC 1716: “the Beatitudes fulfill the promises by ordering them no longer merely to the possession of a territory, but to the Kingdom of heaven:”

3-3-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Beatitudes” teaches? “He lived the Beatitudes.”
3-3-1.why: Francis of Assisi: he lived the Beatitudes.

3-3-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Beatitudes”?
3-3-1.why: Matthew 5:3-12 is the passage for this lesson.

3-3-2.q: True or false: The theological virtues are gifts from God. They help us believe, trust and love.
Which word fits? “Faith, hope and love: gifts from God that lead us to him.”
3-3-2.why: theological virtues: Faith, hope and love: gifts from God that lead us to him.

3-3-2.q: Which word fits? “Trusting God and believing what he has shown us.”
3-3-2.why: faith: Trusting God and believing what he has shown us.

3-3-2.q: Catechism 1822: “_____ is the theological virtue by which we love God above all things for his own sake, and our neighbor as ourselves for the love of God.”
3-3-2.why: CCC 1822: “Charity is the theological virtue by which we love God above all things for his own sake, and our neighbor as ourselves for the love of God.”

3-3-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Faith, hope and love” teaches? “The little way of love.”
3-3-2.why: Thérèse: the little way of love.

3-3-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Faith, hope and love”?
3-3-2.why: 1 Corinthians 13:13 is the passage for this lesson.

3-3-3.q: True or false: The cardinal virtues are habits of living well. They help us choose good.
Which word fits? “Prudence, justice, fortitude and temperance: the habits that good living “hinges” on.”
3-3-3.why: cardinal virtues: Prudence, justice, fortitude and temperance: the habits that good living “hinges” on.

3-3-3.q: Which word fits? “The habit of choosing well how to do good in each situation.”
3-3-3.why: prudence: The habit of choosing well how to do good in each situation.

3-3-3.q: Catechism 1805: “for she teaches _____ and prudence, justice, and courage." These virtues are praised under other names in many passages of Scripture.”
3-3-3.why: CCC 1805: “for she teaches temperance and prudence, justice, and courage." These virtues are praised under other names in many passages of Scripture.”

3-3-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Courage, fairness, wisdom, self-control” teaches? “Courage.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Courage, fairness, wisdom, self-control”?
3-3-3.why: Wisdom 8:7 is the passage for this lesson.

3-4-1.q: True or false: The Son of God became man. He lived among us and he saves us.
Which word fits? “God the Son becoming man: Jesus is true God and true man.”
3-4-1.why: Incarnation: God the Son becoming man: Jesus is true God and true man.

3-4-1.q: Which word fits? “The union of divine and human natures in the one Person of Christ.”
3-4-1.why: hypostatic union: The union of divine and human natures in the one Person of Christ.

3-4-1.q: Catechism 464: “The unique and altogether singular event of the _____ of the Son of God does not mean that Jesus Christ is part God and part man, nor does it imply that he is the result of a confused mixture of the divine and the human.”
3-4-1.why: CCC 464: “The unique and altogether singular event of the Incarnation of the Son of God does not mean that Jesus Christ is part God and part man, nor does it imply that he is the result of a confused mixture of the divine and the human.”

3-4-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Jesus is true God and true man” teaches? “He defended the truth about Jesus.”
3-4-1.why: Athanasius: he defended the truth about Jesus.

3-4-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Jesus is true God and true man”?
3-4-1.why: John 1:1-14 is the passage for this lesson.

3-4-2.q: True or false: Jesus announces the kingdom with words and miracles.
Which word fits? “A wonderful sign of God’s power that goes beyond nature.”
3-4-2.why: miracle: A wonderful sign of God’s power that goes beyond nature.

3-4-2.q: Which word fits? “God’s loving rule, which Jesus began and which will be complete in heaven.”
3-4-2.why: kingdom of God: God’s loving rule, which Jesus began and which will be complete in heaven.

3-4-2.q: Catechism 541: “"Now after John was arrested, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the _____ of God, and saying:”
3-4-2.why: CCC 541: “"Now after John was arrested, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of God, and saying:”

3-4-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Jesus teaches and heals” teaches? “Signs and healings.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Jesus teaches and heals”?
3-4-2.why: Mark 4:35-41 is the passage for this lesson.

3-4-3.q: True or false: Jesus died for our sins and rose on the third day. He opened heaven to us.
Which word fits? “Jesus buying us back from sin and death by his cross and Resurrection.”
3-4-3.why: redemption: Jesus buying us back from sin and death by his cross and Resurrection.

3-4-3.q: Which word fits? “Jesus’ suffering, death, Resurrection and Ascension, by which he saves us.”
3-4-3.why: Paschal Mystery: Jesus’ suffering, death, Resurrection and Ascension, by which he saves us.

3-4-3.q: Catechism 599: “Peter explains to the Jews of Jerusalem in his first sermon on _____:”
3-4-3.why: CCC 599: “Peter explains to the Jews of Jerusalem in his first sermon on Pentecost:”

3-4-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Cross and Resurrection” teaches? “Witness of the Resurrection.”
3-4-3.why: Mary Magdalene: witness of the Resurrection.

3-4-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Cross and Resurrection”?
3-4-3.why: Luke 23:33-46 is the passage for this lesson.

3-5-1.q: True or false: At Pentecost the Holy Spirit came on the apostles. The Church began her mission.
Which word fits? “The day the Holy Spirit came on the apostles; the Church’s birthday.”
3-5-1.why: Pentecost: The day the Holy Spirit came on the apostles; the Church’s birthday.

3-5-1.q: Which word fits? “The third Person of the Trinity, who gives life and makes the Church holy.”
3-5-1.why: Holy Spirit: The third Person of the Trinity, who gives life and makes the Church holy.

3-5-1.q: Catechism 731: “On the day of _____ when the seven weeks of Easter had come to an end, Christ's Passover is fulfilled in the outpouring of the Holy Spirit, manifested, given, and communicated as a divine person:”
3-5-1.why: CCC 731: “On the day of Pentecost when the seven weeks of Easter had come to an end, Christ's Passover is fulfilled in the outpouring of the Holy Spirit, manifested, given, and communicated as a divine person:”

3-5-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Pentecost” teaches? “He preached at Pentecost.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Pentecost”?
3-5-1.why: Acts 2:1-41 is the passage for this lesson.

3-5-2.q: True or false: These four marks help us recognize the Church Jesus founded.
Which word fits? “The people God gathers in Christ, who share one faith and one baptism.”
3-5-2.why: Church: The people God gathers in Christ, who share one faith and one baptism.

3-5-2.q: Which word fits? “A word meaning “universal”: for everyone, everywhere, with the fullness of the faith.”
3-5-2.why: catholic: A word meaning “universal”: for everyone, everywhere, with the fullness of the faith.

3-5-2.q: Catechism 811: “"This is the sole _____ of Christ, which in the Creed we profess to be one, holy, catholic and apostolic." These four characteristics, inseparably linked with each other, indicate essential features of the Church and her mission.”
3-5-2.why: CCC 811: “"This is the sole Church of Christ, which in the Creed we profess to be one, holy, catholic and apostolic." These four characteristics, inseparably linked with each other, indicate essential features of the Church and her mission.”

3-5-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Church is one, holy, catholic, apostolic” teaches? “Apostles.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Church is one, holy, catholic, apostolic”?
3-5-2.why: Ephesians 4:4-6 is the passage for this lesson.

3-5-3.q: True or false: Everyone in the Church has a part. We all share in Jesus’ mission.
Which word fits? “The Bishop of Rome, successor of St Peter, who leads the whole Church.”
3-5-3.why: Pope: The Bishop of Rome, successor of St Peter, who leads the whole Church.

3-5-3.q: Which word fits? “A successor of the apostles who leads the Church in his diocese.”
3-5-3.why: bishop: A successor of the apostles who leads the Church in his diocese.

3-5-3.q: Catechism 871: “"The Christian faithful are those who, inasmuch as they have been incorporated in Christ through _____, have been constituted as the people of God;”
3-5-3.why: CCC 871: “"The Christian faithful are those who, inasmuch as they have been incorporated in Christ through Baptism, have been constituted as the people of God;”

3-5-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Pope, bishops, priests and laypeople” teaches? “A joyful pope.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Pope, bishops, priests and laypeople”?
3-5-3.why: 1 Corinthians 12:12-27 is the passage for this lesson.

3-6-1.q: True or false: Mary is the Mother of God and our mother. She lived by faith.
Which word fits? “The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.”
3-6-1.why: Mary: The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.

3-6-1.q: Which word fits? “Mary’s title because her Son Jesus is God.”
3-6-1.why: Mother of God: Mary’s title because her Son Jesus is God.

3-6-1.q: Catechism 495: “Hence the _____ confesses that Mary is truly "Mother of God" (Theotokos).”
3-6-1.why: CCC 495: “Hence the Church confesses that Mary is truly "Mother of God" (Theotokos).”

3-6-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Mary, Mother of God” teaches? “She prayed the Rosary.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Mary, Mother of God”?
3-6-1.why: Luke 1:39-56 is the passage for this lesson.

3-6-2.q: True or false: All God’s people are united: on earth, in purgatory and in heaven.
Which word fits? “The union of all God’s holy people: on earth, in purgatory and in heaven.”
3-6-2.why: communion of saints: The union of all God’s holy people: on earth, in purgatory and in heaven.

3-6-2.q: Which word fits? “A holy person who is with God in heaven.”
3-6-2.why: saint: A holy person who is with God in heaven.

3-6-2.q: Catechism 946: “After confessing "the holy _____ Church," the Apostles' Creed adds "the communion of saints." In a certain sense this article is a further explanation of the preceding:”
3-6-2.why: CCC 946: “After confessing "the holy catholic Church," the Apostles' Creed adds "the communion of saints." In a certain sense this article is a further explanation of the preceding:”

3-6-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The communion of saints” teaches? “November 1.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The communion of saints”?
3-6-2.why: Hebrews 12:1 is the passage for this lesson.

3-6-3.q: True or false: We are made for heaven. Our choices lead us toward God or away.
Which word fits? “Life with God forever, in perfect happiness.”
3-6-3.why: heaven: Life with God forever, in perfect happiness.

3-6-3.q: Which word fits? “The state of those who die in mortal sin and freely refuse God’s love.”
3-6-3.why: hell: The state of those who die in mortal sin and freely refuse God’s love.

3-6-3.q: Catechism 1023: “By virtue of our _____ authority, we define the following:”
3-6-3.why: CCC 1023: “By virtue of our apostolic authority, we define the following:”

3-6-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Heaven and eternal life” teaches? “The good thief.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Heaven and eternal life”?
3-6-3.why: Revelation 21:1-4 is the passage for this lesson.

3-7-1.q: True or false: Sacraments are signs Jesus gave to give us God’s life. There are seven.
Which word fits? “An outward sign Jesus gave that really gives us God’s grace.”
3-7-1.why: sacrament: An outward sign Jesus gave that really gives us God’s grace.

3-7-1.q: Which word fits? “God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.”
3-7-1.why: grace: God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.

3-7-1.q: Catechism 1113: “The whole liturgical life of the _____ revolves around the Eucharistic sacrifice and the sacraments.”
3-7-1.why: CCC 1113: “The whole liturgical life of the Church revolves around the Eucharistic sacrifice and the sacraments.”

3-7-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “What is a sacrament?” teaches? “Explained the sacraments.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “What is a sacrament?”?
3-7-1.why: John 3:5 is the passage for this lesson.

3-7-2.q: True or false: These three sacraments of initiation bring us into the Church.
Which word fits? “The sacrament of new birth that frees us from sin and makes us God’s children.”
3-7-2.why: Baptism: The sacrament of new birth that frees us from sin and makes us God’s children.

3-7-2.q: Which word fits? “The sacrament that seals us with the Holy Spirit and strengthens us.”
3-7-2.why: Confirmation: The sacrament that seals us with the Holy Spirit and strengthens us.

3-7-2.q: Catechism 1212: “The sacraments of Christian initiation - _____, Confirmation, and the Eucharist - lay the foundations of every Christian life.”
3-7-2.why: CCC 1212: “The sacraments of Christian initiation - Baptism, Confirmation, and the Eucharist - lay the foundations of every Christian life.”

3-7-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Baptism, Confirmation, Eucharist” teaches? “He often reminded the young of their baptism.”
3-7-2.why: Pope St John Paul II: he often reminded the young of their baptism.

3-7-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Baptism, Confirmation, Eucharist”?
3-7-2.why: Acts 2:38-42 is the passage for this lesson.

3-7-3.q: True or false: Healing and service sacraments help us in need and in mission.
Which word fits? “The sacrament of Confession, in which God forgives our sins through the priest.”
3-7-3.why: Reconciliation: The sacrament of Confession, in which God forgives our sins through the priest.

3-7-3.q: Which word fits? “The sacrament that strengthens and heals those who are seriously ill or old.”
3-7-3.why: Anointing of the Sick: The sacrament that strengthens and heals those who are seriously ill or old.

3-7-3.q: Catechism 1421: “the _____ of Penance and the sacrament of Anointing of the Sick.”
3-7-3.why: CCC 1421: “the sacrament of Penance and the sacrament of Anointing of the Sick.”

3-7-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Reconciliation, Anointing, Orders, Matrimony” teaches? “A married couple saint.”
3-7-3.why: Louis and Zélie Martin: a married couple saint.

3-7-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Reconciliation, Anointing, Orders, Matrimony”?
3-7-3.why: James 5:14-15 is the passage for this lesson.

3-8-1.q: True or false: Prayer is raising our hearts to God. We pray because God invites us.
Which word fits? “Raising our minds and hearts to God.”
3-8-1.why: prayer: Raising our minds and hearts to God.

3-8-1.q: Catechism 2558: “it is a simple look turned toward _____, it is a cry of recognition and of love, embracing both trial and joy.”
3-8-1.why: CCC 2558: “it is a simple look turned toward heaven, it is a cry of recognition and of love, embracing both trial and joy.”

3-8-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Why we pray” teaches? “She called prayer friendship.”
3-8-1.why: Teresa of Avila: she called prayer friendship.

3-8-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Why we pray”?
3-8-1.why: Luke 11:1-4 is the passage for this lesson.

3-8-2.q: True or false: We adore, praise, thank, ask and say sorry. Prayer can be vocal, meditation or contemplative.
Which word fits? “Worshiping God as God.”
Which word fits? “Prayer that gives glory to God for who he is.”
3-8-2.why: praise: Prayer that gives glory to God for who he is.

3-8-2.q: Catechism 2628: “_____ is the first attitude of man acknowledging that he is a creature before his Creator.”
3-8-2.why: CCC 2628: “Adoration is the first attitude of man acknowledging that he is a creature before his Creator.”

3-8-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Kinds of prayer” teaches? “She prayed for her son Augustine.”
3-8-2.why: Monica: she prayed for her son Augustine.

3-8-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Kinds of prayer”?
3-8-2.why: Psalm 150 is the passage for this lesson.

3-8-3.q: True or false: The Rosary helps us pray with Mary and remember Jesus’ life.
Which word fits? “A prayer of repeated Hail Marys while meditating on the life of Jesus.”
3-8-3.why: Rosary: A prayer of repeated Hail Marys while meditating on the life of Jesus.

3-8-3.q: Catechism 971: “"The _____'s devotion to the Blessed Virgin is intrinsic to Christian worship." The Church rightly honors "the Blessed Virgin with special devotion.”
3-8-3.why: CCC 971: “"The Church's devotion to the Blessed Virgin is intrinsic to Christian worship." The Church rightly honors "the Blessed Virgin with special devotion.”

3-8-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Rosary” teaches? “Rosary devotion.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Rosary”?
3-8-3.why: Luke 1:46-55 is the passage for this lesson.

3-9-1.q: True or false: Sunday is the Lord’s Day. We go to Mass and rest.
Which word fits? “The Lord’s Day, when we remember the Resurrection and rest and worship.”
3-9-1.why: Sunday: The Lord’s Day, when we remember the Resurrection and rest and worship.

3-9-1.q: Which word fits? “The Church’s highest prayer, in which Jesus’ sacrifice is made present and we receive him.”
3-9-1.why: Mass: The Church’s highest prayer, in which Jesus’ sacrifice is made present and we receive him.

3-9-1.q: Catechism 2174: “Jesus rose from the dead "on the first day of the week." Because it is the "first day," the day of Christ's _____ recalls the first creation.”
3-9-1.why: CCC 2174: “Jesus rose from the dead "on the first day of the week." Because it is the "first day," the day of Christ's Resurrection recalls the first creation.”

3-9-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Sunday and the Mass” teaches? “Dies Domini.”
3-9-1.why: Pope St John Paul II: Dies Domini.

3-9-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Sunday and the Mass”?
3-9-1.why: Psalm 118:24 is the passage for this lesson.

3-9-2.q: True or false: The Church year has seasons that tell Jesus’ story with colors.
Which word fits? “The Church’s year of seasons that retells the life of Christ.”
3-9-2.why: liturgical year: The Church’s year of seasons that retells the life of Christ.

3-9-2.q: Which word fits? “The season of preparing for Christmas.”
3-9-2.why: Advent: The season of preparing for Christmas.

3-9-2.q: Catechism 1163: “"Holy Mother _____ believes that she should celebrate the saving work of her divine Spouse in a sacred commemoration on certain days throughout the course of the year.”
3-9-2.why: CCC 1163: “"Holy Mother Church believes that she should celebrate the saving work of her divine Spouse in a sacred commemoration on certain days throughout the course of the year.”

3-9-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Seasons and colors” teaches? “Shaped the liturgy.”
3-9-2.why: Pope Gregory I: shaped the liturgy.

3-9-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Seasons and colors”?
3-9-2.why: Isaiah 40:1-5 is the passage for this lesson.

3-9-3.q: True or false: Special feasts honor Mary and the saints. They teach us how to follow Christ.
Which word fits? “A special feast on which Catholics are bound to go to Mass.”
3-9-3.why: holy day of obligation: A special feast on which Catholics are bound to go to Mass.

3-9-3.q: Which word fits? “A holy person who is with God in heaven.”
3-9-3.why: saint: A holy person who is with God in heaven.

3-9-3.q: Catechism 1172: “"In celebrating this annual cycle of the mysteries of Christ, Holy _____ honors the Blessed Mary, Mother of God, with a special love.”
3-9-3.why: CCC 1172: “"In celebrating this annual cycle of the mysteries of Christ, Holy Church honors the Blessed Mary, Mother of God, with a special love.”

3-9-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Holy days and the saints’ feasts” teaches? “Honored on many feasts.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Holy days and the saints’ feasts”?
3-9-3.why: Revelation 7:9-17 is the passage for this lesson.
